Your information & your rights

Delivery & refunds

Version 2026-10-01. Last updated 1 October 2026.

In short

  • harni.uk takes no orders and no payments. Amazon sells and delivers my books.
  • For delivery, returns or refunds, use your Amazon account and Amazon's help.
  • If something is wrong with the book itself, email me and I will look into it.

On this page

  1. Who sells the books
  2. Paperbacks
  3. Kindle ebooks and Kindle Unlimited
  4. Your rights
  5. A problem with the book itself

Who sells the books

harni.uk is an author website and catalogue. It does not sell or deliver books and it does not take payment. Every purchase button opens the book's page on Amazon.co.uk, where the listing shows the seller, the formats, the price and the purchase terms. Your contract for a purchase is with the seller named by Amazon.

Paperbacks

Check the delivery estimate and the seller on Amazon before you order. For a late, missing, damaged or wrong item, start from the order in your Amazon account and follow the seller's support and returns process. Time limits and who pays for a return depend on the terms that apply to your order and on your legal rights.

Kindle ebooks and Kindle Unlimited

Amazon handles Kindle purchases, downloads and account access. Check that your device or app is compatible and that you have the right edition before you buy. For a download problem or a refund request, use Amazon's Kindle or order support. Kindle Unlimited borrowing is governed by Amazon's terms.

Your rights

This page does not set a separate return window or refund policy, because I do not sell the books. Use the terms that apply to your order, and the rights the law gives you, including your rights as a consumer. Nothing on this site reduces them. I cannot see your Amazon account, process a refund for Amazon, or cancel an Amazon order.

A problem with the book itself

If you find a typo, a factual concern or a formatting or printing fault, email info@harni.uk or use the contact page, and tell me the title, the format, the chapter or page, and what is wrong. For physical damage or a printing fault, also contact the seller through Amazon so they can deal with the order. Please do not send card details, passwords or unnecessary personal information. You can also visit Amazon Customer Service.
